1Choosing an AI solution

Consideration Question
Implementation speed How fast must it be live?
Development effort How much work can we invest?
Business differentiation Must it be unique to us, or is standard enough?
Technical expertise Do we have data scientists and engineers?
Choice and flexibility Do we need many models and tools, with no lock-in?

The trade-off: ready-made = fastest, least effort, least differentiation. Custom = most effort and expertise, most differentiation.

Approach Use when
Pre-trained APIs and foundation models A common task (translate, transcribe, see, write) and you want speed
AutoML (train on your data, little code) Your data and labels, limited ML expertise
Custom models Unique needs and strong ML skills
Exam tip

. Speed and low effort → pre-trained. Own data, low expertise → AutoML. Unique advantage, high expertise → custom.

2Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform

Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (often just Agent Platform; it is the Google Cloud AI developer platform earlier named Vertex AI) is the open, all-in-one platform for technical teams to build, scale, govern and optimize enterprise-grade AI agents and applications grounded in company data.

Capability What it gives
Model Garden 200+ models: Google's Gemini, partner and open models
Agent Studio Build and customize agents and generative AI apps with Gemini
AutoML Train custom models on your data with little code
Custom training and notebooks Your own models with frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch; notebooks integrated with BigQuery
MLOps Model Registry, Pipelines, Model Evaluation, Feature Store, monitoring for drift
Governance Register, manage and secure the agents of the organization

Gemini Enterprise is the AI platform for employees: a place to discover, create, share and run AI agents at work, with pre-built agents and applications. Agent Platform is for builders; Gemini Enterprise is for the workforce.

3Pre-trained APIs and foundation models

Product Use case
Gemini (through the Agent Platform API) Multimodal foundation models: text, images, code, audio, video; chat, summarize, reason, create
Vision API Understand images: labels, objects, text (OCR), faces
Cloud Translation API Translate text between languages
Speech-to-Text API Transcribe speech to text
Text-to-Speech Turn text into natural speech
Natural Language API Analyze text: sentiment, entities
Exam tip

. Picture → Vision. Languages → Translation. Audio to words → Speech-to-Text. Open-ended generation or chat → Gemini.

4AI Hypercomputer

AI Hypercomputer is Google Cloud's integrated supercomputing architecture to train, tune and serve AI.

Component Fact
Purpose-built hardware GPUs and Google's own Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), plus storage and networking built for AI
Open software Industry-leading software and open standards (popular frameworks and tools)
Flexible consumption Cost control with options such as Dynamic Workload Scheduler and spot VMs

Business benefit: better performance and efficiency and lower cost per AI workload.

5BigQuery ML

BigQuery ML lets analysts create and run ML models inside BigQuery with standard SQL, without moving data or writing Python, and experiment quickly.

Exam tip

. BigQuery ML = SQL users build ML models where the data already lives.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A company wants to add translation to its app quickly, without ML expertise. Which solution fits best?

  • ACloud Translation API, a pre-trained API
  • BA custom model built from scratch by a research team
  • CA new data warehouse for translations
  • DAn AI Hypercomputer cluster of TPUs
Show the answer

Answer: A. A pre-trained API gives speed and low effort for a common task such as translation.

S2A retailer has labeled product images and limited ML expertise and wants a model for its own categories. Which approach fits?

  • AOnly a pre-trained speech API
  • BA hand-built model by a research team
  • CA manual spreadsheet of image labels
  • DAutoML, trained on its own data with little code
Show the answer

Answer: D. AutoML trains a custom model on the company's own data with little code.

S3A team of data scientists needs a unique model that gives a lasting competitive advantage. What should they consider?

  • AA pre-trained API used with no changes at all
  • BA software-as-a-service productivity tool
  • CA custom model built on the Agent Platform
  • DA static report built in a spreadsheet
Show the answer

Answer: C. Custom models give the most differentiation and need the most expertise.

S4Which statement best describes Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?

  • AA relational database for global transactions
  • BAn open, all-in-one platform to build, scale and govern AI agents
  • CA tool that only translates text into other languages
  • DA firewall that blocks denial-of-service attacks
Show the answer

Answer: B. Agent Platform is the AI developer platform for building, scaling, governing and optimizing agents.

S5A company wants employees to discover, create and run AI agents at work. Which offering is the best fit?

  • ASpanner, a global relational database
  • BCloud Armor, a network protection service
  • CGemini Enterprise, the AI platform for employees
  • DLooker, a business intelligence platform
Show the answer

Answer: C. Gemini Enterprise is the platform for employees to find, build and run agents.

S6Analysts who only know SQL want to build a prediction model on data in BigQuery. Which feature fits?

  • ABigQuery ML
  • BSpeech-to-Text API
  • CCloud Storage Archive class
  • DApigee API Management
Show the answer

Answer: A. BigQuery ML builds and runs ML models with standard SQL inside BigQuery.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which API understands images?

Show the answer

The Vision API.

R2What does AutoML do?

Show the answer

Trains custom models on your data with little code.

R3What is Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform earlier known as?

Show the answer

R4What are the parts of AI Hypercomputer?

Show the answer

R5What does BigQuery ML use to build models?

Show the answer

R6What is a TPU?

Show the answer
